messages:
Eva (AE): Quick sync — need to finalise ACME POC success criteria before EOD Thu. Focus: latency, cost, quality, timeline.
Mike (SE): Re latency: suggest p50 <120ms, p95 <350ms for typical 1k-token average. For initial demo we can relax to p95 <400ms.
Sarah (ML Eng): Quality proposal: 3 eval suites — (1) 50 human acceptance prompts, (2) 2000 automated semantic sims (SBERT cosine >= 0.82), (3) safety checks (toxicity + PII) pass rate >= 99%. Acceptance = human pass >= 85% AND auto sims >= 88%.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Timeline: 2-day automated runs + 1 day human spot-check. Customer expects an acceptance decision by month-end. Can start infra Tuesday.
Eva (AE): Pricing note from ACME: they want committed pricing if we can show predictable perf. Need a ballpark for ~100k tokens/day and 1 reserved GPU for 4 weeks.
Mike (SE): Ballpark calc: reserved A10G-style node ~ $X/day (region dependent). Hosted consumption example: ~ $0.02 / 1k tokens (placeholder) — I'll produce a concrete model after we lock batch size and quant settings.
Sarah (ML Eng): Add quant variants to the POC: fp16 baseline vs 4-bit quant. We'll measure throughput, p95, and semantic-sim quality. Include a compact table in the report.
security-bot: Security checklist status: 70% complete. Outstanding: network diagram, KMS key management details, and retention policy. Questionnaire link: https://secure.example.com/q/ACME-POC
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Will drop network sketch and KMS answers by tomorrow morning. Confirmed customer retention ask = 90 days for logs, redact PII before retention.
Eva (AE): Draft acceptance checklist (for POC handoff):
```
- Latency: demo p95 <= 400ms; SLA target p95 <= 350ms
- Cost: hosted consumption <= $Y per 1M tokens OR equivalent reserved node price cap
- Quality: human accept >= 85% AND automated sims >= 88%
- Safety: automated filters pass >= 99%
- Security: questionnaire complete + KMS + infra diagram uploaded
```
Mike (SE): Also add operational guardrails: canary rollout (10%), autoscale thresholds, and fallback to smaller model variant on high error rate. We'll add model routing table to the runbook.
Sarah (ML Eng): For prompts: I'll author 3 canonical templates and 30 adversarial examples. Eval harness will produce pass/fail CSV and semantic score histogram.
Eva (AE): Action items:
- Mike: provide detailed cost model + perf baseline (A/B fp16 vs 4-bit) by EOD.
- Sarah: deliver eval suites, prompts, and initial results by EOD.
- Jordan: upload network diagram + confirm retention + complete missing security answers by tomorrow AM.
- security-bot: nudge ACME contact with questionnaire link and deadline.
If we hit these, I can present a single-slide acceptance summary to ACME PM on Friday.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Ack, will ping if anything blocks.
Eva (AE): :thumbsup:
